## Validation

- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s backend/tests` (when backend code changes)

## Checklist

- [ ] Related documentation is updated.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots or a short recording using synthetic data, when applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, real patient information, or identifiable chat transcripts are included.
- [ ] Changes to data collection, network behavior, permissions, notifications, or providers are described.
- [ ] Health content and translations are clearly marked for qualified review before real-world use.
